description_html:
This large one bedroom flat is overlooking the Barbican gardens, the inwards facing flats rarely come to the market. With a large reception room facing east with views of St. Giles Cripplegate church. The reception room has an l-shape with the original devider and three large windows with a door leading to the balcony, there is an original style kitchen, bathroom and bedroom.

Seddon House was named after George Seddon, a master cabinet maker who established a huge furniture emporium on Aldersgate Street. Completed in 1974 with 75 flats its one of the smaller blocks on the Barbican estate with a lift that goes directly down to the residents gardens.
Just a short walk to the shops on Aldersgate Street and a full size Waitrose on Whitecross Street.

Close to both St.Pauls and Farringdon stations with access to the Central Line, Elizabeth line, Circle and Hammersmith and City.

Tenure: Leasehold
Service Charge: £5,597
Council Tax Band: Not yet available
